name: api-crf
description:
Use this agent for API-focused tasks in the martine project: designing new API routes, Zod schema definition, external integrations (Renault Connect, OneSignal, Google Drive, Email), and REST API conventions.

<example>
Context: User wants to add a new API endpoint.
user: "Add an endpoint to bulk-approve multiple reservations at once"
assistant: "I'll use the API agent to design and implement the bulk-approve endpoint with proper validation and auth."
<commentary>
New API route with business logic = API agent.
</commentary>
</example>

<example>
Context: User wants to integrate a new service.
user: "Send an email notification when a reservation is approved"
assistant: "Let me use the API agent to integrate the email service into the reservation approval flow."
<commentary>
External integration = API agent.
</commentary>
</example>

description:

assistant: "I'll use the DBA agent to write the migration script and update all affected queries."

</commentary>
</example>

<example>

user: "The trips list is taking 2 seconds to load, can we optimize the query?"
assistant: "Let me use the DBA agent to analyze and optimize that query."
<commentary>
Query performance investigation = DBA agent.
</commentary>
</example>
